# Sheets: before and after {#sec-sheets}

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/edges.R")
sheets <- read_csv("generated/sheets.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
has_counts <- "matching" %in% names(sheets)
```

Left is the PDF page as rendered for tracing; right is the same page of `bowser.svg` with only the traced pieces: cut outlines in black, mountain folds blue dash-dot, valley folds green dashed and edge numbers in purple (orange where the reader was unsure). Each edge number is ringed <span style="color:#2e7d32">green</span> when its glue pair checks out and <span style="color:#d32f2f">red</span> when it needs work; hover a ring to see why. See @sec-glue for the full list.

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (s in transpose(sheets)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n## Page %02d · %s {#sec-page-%02d}\n\n", s$page, s$label, s$page))
  if (has_counts) cat(sprintf("%d edge numbers matching, %d need work.\n\n", s$matching, s$`needs work`))
  cat("::: {layout-ncol=2}\n")
  if (!is.na(s$before)) cat(sprintf("![Source PDF](%s){.lightbox group=\"page-%02d\"}\n\n", s$before, s$page))
  cat(sprintf("![Traced SVG](%s){.lightbox group=\"page-%02d\"}\n", s$after, s$page))
  cat(":::\n")
}
```
